title: F1 WAG Alexandra Saint Mleux Marries F1 Driver Charles Leclerc In Custom Paolo Sebastian Gown | Fashion News - News18
text: Alexandra Saint Mleux, the quintessential fashion IT girl, is now married to her long-time partner, Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc. The duo got married in a simple civil ceremony on March 2, and details from their wedding are only now trickling out. For part one of her wedding, Alexandra Saint Mleux chose a custom Paolo Sebastian gown. The couple said “I do" in Monaco, but it was the bride’s wedding dress that caught all the attention. It had a scalloped, off-the-shoulder neckline, with long sleeves, and a fitted bodice. The dress was made with floral, French Chantilly lace, which decorated every square inch of her gown. Her gown’s bodice had delicate hand-embridered butterflies and fairy-like embroidery, which continued all the way down to her cathedral train. Nearly-invisible, cascading buttons stopped just above her fit-and-flare, tulle-lined bustle, reported Marie Claire Alexandra Saint Mleux didn’t wear a veil. She had tiny baby’s breath flowers decorating her slick-back bun, and she carried a bouquet of white flowers. She wore her engagement ring along with a pendant tennis necklace. According to previous reports by Daily Mail, Alexandre Saint Mleux’s ring is worth at least £400,000, shares Laura Taylor, a jewellery expert. She said, “Alexandra’s engagement ring features a gorgeous oval cut diamond set on a platinum pavé band. The diamond looks to be around 5 to 6 carats, with a truly bright appearance that suggests it’s of exceptional quality. If the diamond is natural and of exceptional quality, I’d estimate the ring to be worth upwards of £400,000." Details about the civil wedding Charles Leclerc drove his lady love in just any car to the ceremony. The F1 driver, who represents Ferrari, was seen driving a 1957 Ferrari 250 Testa Rossa — one of the Italian marque’s most iconic models. The car, which costs around £9million, remains one of the most sought-after vintage Ferraris ever built. The 28-year-old Monegasque driver and his influencer partner, Alexandra Saint-Mleux, 23, were filmed driving along a scenic coastal road in what looked very much like a post-ceremony getaway. Behind them trailed three motorbikes and a black Mercedes, in footage that quickly spread across social media. The Ferrari driver, who hails from Monte Carlo, is reportedly worth an estimated £92 million. The ceremony took place at the Villa La Vigie in France. It is an iconic spot and has a major part of fashion history, which are two topics that are close to Alexandra Saint Mleux. The Villa La Vigie is a historic villa in Roquebrune-Cap-Martin on the Côte d’Azur in southeastern France. It was built in 1902 by the British publisher Sir William Ingram, 1st Baronet, and was later occupied and renovated by the German fashion designer Karl Lagerfeld starting in the late 1980s. Who is Alexandra Saint Mleux? Charles Leclerc and Alexandra Saint Mleux were first spotted together in March 2023 by eagle-eyed fans, who noticed her in the background of a TikTok video taken of Charles at Paris Fashion Week. The F1 driver confirmed their relationship later that year, in May, during an interview with Gala France. She was then seen, for the first time, at the Monaco Formula 1 Grand Prix as an official guest with Charles’ Ferrari team. Since then, she, along with Leo, the couple’s dog, has been a stylish permanent fixture at all races. The TikTok star and influencer has always been supportive of Charles Leclerc at every race, whether he won or lost. After being spotted at Paris Fashion Week in March, the couple then attended the Wimbledon Tennis Championships in July 2023. This marked the couple’s first public outing after they confirmed their relationship. Alexandra is a public figure and has amassed more than 2 million followers on TikTok and nearly 4 million followers on Instagram. She is very low-key on social media, only sharing a few curated posts a year. The influencer posts makeup and baking tutorials to behind-the-scenes footage from her travels around the world. Alexandra also manages a second Instagram account, where she documents her love of art.
